anchors.originalVerificationExcerpt:
- name: Qualify packaged Windows same-Main Retry and original Processes UI Kill with finite peers
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $bundle = (Resolve-Path '${{ matrix.bundle }}').Path
          $apps = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $bundle -File -Filter '*.exe' | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch 'uninstall' })
          if ($apps.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Expected one original packaged application executable' }
          $app = $apps[0].FullName
          $broker = Join-Path $bundle 'resources\legacy-agent-host\windows-retry-custody\owned-process-broker.exe'
          $query = Join-Path $env:WINDOWS_RETRY_BUILD 'Release\owned-process-fixture.exe'
          $receipt = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-same-main-process-ui.json'
          $controller = Join-Path $env:WINDOWS_RETRY_BUILD 'Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe'
          $controllerHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $controller).Hash
          $controllerLog = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-same-main-process-ui.controller.log'
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $loader = ([System.Uri]((Resolve-Path 'node_modules\tsx\dist\loader.mjs').Path)).AbsoluteUri
          $gate = (Resolve-Path 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeWindowsAppGate.mjs').Path
          $env:TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH = (Resolve-Path 'tsconfig.json').Path
          & $controller $node --import $loader $gate $app $broker $query $receipt 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $controllerLog
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original controller did not confirm finite UI cleanup' }
          if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $controller).Hash -ne $controllerHash) { throw 'Original controller changed' }
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs';const b=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]);assert.ok(b.length>0&&b.length<=65536);const lines=b.toString('utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/u);const rows=lines.filter(line=>line.startsWith('{')).map(line=>JSON.parse(line)).filter(row=>row.gateController!==undefined);assert.deepEqual(rows,[{gateController:'drained',rootExitCode:0,activeProcesses:0}]);" $controllerLog
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Exact original controller accounting refused' }
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs';const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8'));assert.equal(r.kind,'TEST_WINDOWS_PACKAGED_SAME_MAIN_PROCESS_UI');assert.equal(r.status,'PASS');assert.equal(r.cleanup,true);assert.equal(r.sourceHead,process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA);assert.equal(r.platform,'win32-'+process.arch);assert.deepEqual(r.counts,{mainStarts:1,initialRuntimeOpen:1,businessInput:1,refreshClicks:1,retryClicks:1,uiStops:2,quit:1});assert.equal(r.actualHostSuccessors,1);assert.equal(r.originalRuntimeGenerations,1);assert.equal(r.modelRequests,0);assert.equal(r.modelProbes,0);assert.equal(r.realVendorExecutions,0);assert.equal(r.peer.provider,'codex');assert.equal(r.peer.connected,1);assert.equal(r.peer.registrations,1);assert.equal(r.peer.serviceExitObservations,2);assert.equal(r.peer.failures,0);assert.deepEqual(r.nativeCleanup,{phase:'completed',cleanup:true,originalQueryWitnesses:3,runtimeGenerations:1,runtimeInputs:1,modelRequests:0,probes:0,realVendorExecutions:0,originalUiStops:2,serviceExitObservations:2});assert.equal(r.packagedAndNativeInputsUnchanged,true);assert.equal(r.sourceFreezeFailure,undefined);assert.equal(r.peerEvidenceFailure,undefined);assert.equal(r.originalMain.pid,r.sameMainAfterRetry.pid);assert.equal(r.originalMain.birth,r.sameMainAfterRetry.birth);" $receipt
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Exact finite same-Main UI receipt refused' }
